text:
maria: Quick sync — GreenTide case study needs wrap. They approved the draft story but legal still needs to sign off on the quote. Also CEO interview to capture the soundbite + one-slide customer story. Can legal confirm quote language by EOD Fri? We want to slot the interview into next Tue so we can hit the webinar on Apr 14.
josh: Thanks — where's the draft? paste link pls. I can patch copy and pull the transcript.
josh: https://docs.google.com/greentide-case-draft (draft Qs in the doc, bottom section)
kevin: I can take the 1-slide design + quick product screenshots. Need logo (svg) + headshot + a short 2-sentence byline from their comms lead.
lia: FYI GreenTide asked to redact MRR and any raw customer revenue numbers. They're fine with % uplift and an anonymized ARR band.
priya: Routing note — inbound webinar leads from this co should go to AE queue for West region (assign to @kelly). Can ops set a hidden field on the form: source=greentide?
sara: I can do a quick read. Please post the EXACT quote you plan to publish. Also confirm we have a signed quote release from the customer (or we need one).
maria: Pasting proposed published quote below (from GreenTide CTO):
```
"Redwood reduced inference latency threefold and cut per-token costs by ~47%, enabling us to deliver faster features to customers at a lower price point."
```

sara: Quick redlines: change 'threefold' spelled out is fine, change 'cut' -> 'reduced' for tone, and change 'by ~47%' to 'approximately 47%'. Also need an explicit clause: "Customer grants Redwood permission to publish the quote and logo on or after the agreed publish date." Do we have that?
maria: Not yet. I can ask their comms lead to sign an approval email.
josh: Scheduling — CEO availability: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 16:00-16:30 PT. I've put both options in the doc. Which does design prefer?
kevin: Tue 10:00 PT works for me. I can do remote video grab + stills.
priya: Tue 10 also works for AE handoff timeline. I'll prep the webinar landing page with hidden field source=greentide and tag @kelly for lead routing.
lia: I'll collect headshot + logo + anonymized metrics from their CS contact and upload to the shared folder by EOD Mon.
sara: Once Maria posts the finalized quote and the approval email, I can sign off. If the customer is okay, legal ok to publish on Apr 14 embargo.
maria: I updated the draft with Sara's wording and added the approval clause. Pasted updated quote: 
```
"Redwood reduced inference latency threefold and reduced per-token costs by approximately 47%, enabling us to deliver faster features to customers at a lower price point." — GreenTide CTO
```

sara: That reads clean. Two asks: 1) get the explicit email approval from GreenTide that mentions the publish date; 2) confirm we will not use customer revenue figures. If both true, legal signs off.
josh: I'll prepare the transcript + soundbite edit after the interview. Can we record?
maria: Customer ok with recording. Kevin, please enable recording.
calendar-bot: Event created — "GreenTide CEO interview" Tue 10:00 PT — invite sent to maria, josh, kevin, lia, priya.
kevin: Recording & remote capture confirmed. Will drop a checklist in the doc: mic check, screenshot list, slide mock.
priya: Webinar ops note: we'll set pre-webinar nurture to include a short case-study teaser linking to the landing page (CTA: book a demo). Routing to @kelly.
lia: Uploaded headshot + logo (svg) to /shared/marketing/greentide/assets. Also uploaded redacted metrics: "~47% cost reduction; threefold latency improvement; ARR band: 10-50M"
maria: Got it. I emailed GreenTide comms for the sign-off email — asked them to reply with the exact publish date and attach logo usage permission.
sara: Once that email lands, ping me and I'll add the final sign-off stamp.
josh: Small copy ask — on the webinar slide, can we call the case study 'Reducing inference cost at scale' rather than mentioning the customer in the title? Keeps the hero slide GDPR-friendly pre-approval.
kevin: Good call. I'll design hero slide generically and then swap in GreenTide logo post-approval.
maria: Final checklist: 1) Customer sign-off email with publish date & logo permission (maria) 2) Legal sign-off (sara) 3) Assets in folder (lia) 4) Interview recorded Tue 10 (kevin/josh) 5) Webinar landing + lead routing to @kelly (priya) 6) Design slide + one-pager (kevin) — target publish & webinar Apr 14.
priya: I'll set a calendar reminder to cut the nurture flow on Apr 12 if legal gives the greenlight.
sara: Confirming — I'll be on standby. If the approval arrives by Mon EOD we can make Apr 14. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks team — will keep this thread updated. :pray:
